column3: grey spots on leaves,neck rot,white panicle,diamond shaped lesions
column4: Spray tricyclazole 0.06 percent at boot leaf stage. Avoid excess nitrogen and keep a thin water film in the field.

column3: yellow leaf margins,drying of leaf tips,wilting of seedlings,wavy leaf edges
column4: Use resistant varieties. Spray streptocycline with copper oxychloride and drain the field for two days.

column3: brown oval spots,dark brown lesions,weak grain filling
column4: Apply mancozeb 0.25 percent. Correct potassium and zinc deficiency in the soil.

column3: greenish grey lesions on sheath,snake skin pattern,drying of leaves
column4: Spray hexaconazole or validamycin. Avoid close spacing and heavy nitrogen dose.

column3: orange pustules,yellow stripes on leaves,reddish brown powder,drying of leaves
column4: Spray propiconazole 0.1 percent at first appearance and repeat after fifteen days.

column3: white powdery patches,leaf curling,stunted growth,whitish coating on stem
column4: Spray wettable sulphur 0.2 percent or dinocap in the early morning hours.

column3: black powder in grain,fishy smell,partial grain damage
column4: Treat seed with carboxin and spray propiconazole at ear emergence.

column3: black powdery ear head,ear replaced by black mass,early ear emergence
column4: Treat the seed with carboxin or use solar heat treatment before sowing.

column3: yellow patches on upper leaf,white growth on lower leaf,drying of leaf tips,downy fungal mass
column4: Spray metalaxyl with mancozeb and improve drainage of the field.

column3: long brown lesions,drying of leaves,boat shaped spots
column4: Spray mancozeb 0.25 percent twice at ten day intervals and remove infected lower leaves.

column3: discoloured grain,fungal growth on ear head,black or pink grain
column4: Harvest at the right maturity and dry the grain quickly. Spray captan if rain occurs at grain filling.

column3: honey dew from florets,dark sclerotia in ear head,sticky ear head
column4: Remove and burn the infected ear heads. Treat seed in twenty percent salt solution before sowing.

column3: sudden drooping,yellowing of lower leaves,vascular browning,drying of whole plant
column4: Drench the soil with carbendazim and follow crop rotation with a non host crop.

column3: brown spots with dark rings,drying of stem,broken stem at node
column4: Spray chlorothalonil and use certified disease free seed.

column3: rotting at soil level,white fungal growth at collar,seedling collapse
column4: Treat seed with trichoderma. Avoid deep sowing and improve drainage of the field.

column3: bushy pale plant,no flowering,small leaves
column4: Remove infected plants early and control the eriophyid mite with sulphur spray.

column3: yellow mosaic patches,puckering of leaves,stunted growth
column4: Control the whitefly vector and sow resistant varieties within the recommended window.

column3: circular brown spots with grey centre,premature leaf fall
column4: Spray carbendazim or mancozeb twice at fifteen day intervals.

column3: dark brown circular spots,premature leaf fall,weak pod filling
column4: Spray chlorothalonil or carbendazim twice starting at forty days after sowing.

column3: small raised pustules,brown angular spots,drying of leaves
column4: Spray streptocycline with copper oxychloride and use clean certified seed.

column3: white pustules on lower leaf,swollen flower stalk,leaf curling
column4: Spray metalaxyl with mancozeb and remove the deformed flower stalks.

column3: dark concentric spots,brown lesions on pod,drying of leaves
column4: Spray mancozeb 0.25 percent at first symptom and repeat after fifteen days.

column3: rotting of back of head,white fungal growth,fallen seeds
column4: Avoid overhead irrigation at flowering and spray carbendazim on the head.

column3: flowers turn into green leaves,no seed set,bushy top
column4: Remove infected plants and control the leafhopper vector with imidacloprid.

column3: blackening of stem,rotting near soil,drying of whole plant
column4: Treat seed with carbendazim and follow three year crop rotation.

column3: upward curling of leaves,thickened veins,yellowing of leaf edges,stunted growth,leathery leaves
column4: Control the whitefly vector with imidacloprid and remove infected plants from the field.

column3: rotting of bolls,discoloured lint,dark sunken spots on boll
column4: Spray copper oxychloride and remove damaged bolls. Control the pink bollworm properly.

column3: angular water soaked spots,black arm on stem,oily spots on fruit
column4: Spray streptocycline with copper oxychloride and destroy infected plant residue.

column3: red discolouration inside stem,alcoholic smell,drying of leaves,shrunken internodes
column4: Remove and burn infected clumps. Plant only healthy setts treated with carbendazim.

column3: black whip like shoot,thin grassy tillers,stunted clump
column4: Remove the whips before they burst and treat setts with hot water and carbendazim.

column3: many thin tillers,pale white leaves,no cane formation
column4: Use disease free seed cane and treat setts by moist hot air treatment.

column3: blackening of stem base,sudden wilting,black discs inside stem
column4: Drench with metalaxyl and rotate with a non host crop for three years.

column3: concentric rings on leaves,brown spots,yellowing around the spots,leaf drop,target board pattern
column4: Spray mancozeb 0.25 percent every ten days and remove the lower infected leaves.

column3: water soaked lesions,white fungal growth,blackening of stem,rotting tuber
column4: Spray metalaxyl with mancozeb immediately in cloudy humid weather and destroy infected plants.

column3: black hard crusts on tuber,stunted sprouts,brown lesions on stolon
column4: Treat the seed tubers with boric acid solution and follow a long crop rotation.

column3: seedling collapse,rotting at soil level,water soaked lesions
column4: Drench the nursery with copper oxychloride and avoid excess watering of the beds.

column3: purple lesions on leaves,leaf tip drying,neck rot
column4: Spray mancozeb with a sticker at ten day intervals starting forty five days after transplanting.

column3: rotting of the base plate,yellowing of leaves,easy pulling of the plant
column4: Treat the bulbs with carbendazim before planting and improve field drainage.

column3: sudden wilting without yellowing,white ooze from cut stem,drying of whole plant
column4: Remove infected plants at once and rotate with a cereal crop. Apply bleaching powder in the soil.

column3: grey spots on leaves,sunken spots on fruit,fruit rot
column4: Spray carbendazim and use clean certified seed from a healthy crop.

column3: very small leaves,bushy growth,no fruit set
column4: Remove infected plants and control the leafhopper vector with dimethoate.

column3: yellow network of veins,small hard fruit,stunted growth
column4: Control the whitefly vector and grow resistant varieties. Remove infected plants early.

column3: V shaped yellow patches at leaf margin,black veins,drying of leaves
column4: Treat the seed in hot water and spray streptocycline with copper oxychloride.

column3: swollen club shaped roots,wilting in hot sun,stunted growth
column4: Apply lime to raise the soil pH and follow a long rotation with non cruciferous crops.

column3: yellowing of one side,drooping of vine,brown vascular tissue
column4: Use resistant varieties and drench with carbendazim. Avoid growing cucurbits in the same field.

column3: sunken dark spots on fruit,fruit rot,twig dieback,black lesions on leaf
column4: Spray carbendazim 0.1 percent and collect and burn all the fallen infected fruit.

column3: yellowing of lower leaves,soft rotting rhizome,drying of leaves,foul smell
column4: Drench with metalaxyl and mancozeb and provide good drainage in the beds.

column3: brown spots with yellow halo,drying of leaves,premature leaf fall
column4: Spray mancozeb or carbendazim at fifteen day intervals and remove fallen leaves.

column3: yellowing of lower leaves,splitting of pseudostem,sudden drooping,brown vascular tissue
column4: Use tissue culture plants and drench with carbendazim. Avoid replanting banana in infected fields.

column3: yellow streaks on leaves,dark spots with grey centre,drying of leaves
column4: Spray propiconazole with mineral oil and remove the badly infected old leaves.

column3: bunched crown of small leaves,dark green streaks on midrib,stunted growth
column4: Remove and destroy infected plants with the corm and control the banana aphid vector.

column3: deformed bunched flower head,thick swollen shoot,no fruit set
column4: Prune and destroy the malformed panicles and spray naphthalene acetic acid in October.

column3: rough corky spots on fruit,raised brown lesions,cracked fruit
column4: Spray copper oxychloride and prune out the affected twigs during the dry season.

column3: ring shaped spots on fruit,yellow mottled leaves,oily streaks on stem
column4: Remove infected plants early and control the aphid vector. Use a barrier crop of maize.

column3: raised corky spots with yellow halo,leaf fall,twig dieback
column4: Spray streptocycline with copper oxychloride and prune out infected twigs.

column3: gum oozing from trunk,bark cracking,yellowing of leaves
column4: Scrape the affected bark and apply bordeaux paste. Avoid water stagnation near the trunk.

column3: dark sunken spots on fruit,cracked fruit,fruit rot
column4: Spray mancozeb with copper oxychloride and remove all the fallen fruit from the orchard.

column3: rotting of the central spindle leaf,foul smell,drooping crown
column4: Remove the rotten tissue and apply bordeaux paste. Improve drainage around the palm basin.

column3: sudden yellowing of vine,black lesions on stem,defoliation of the vine
column4: Drench with potassium phosphonate and provide sharp drainage in the monsoon.

column3: translucent blisters on leaf,white powder on lower side,shot hole in leaf
column4: Spray copper oxychloride at weekly intervals during the wet monsoon months.

column3: orange yellow powder on lower leaf,heavy leaf fall,dieback of twigs
column4: Spray bordeaux mixture before and after the monsoon and maintain proper shade.

column3: drying of twigs from the tip,black shrivelled shoot,leaf fall
column4: Prune the affected shoots well below the dry portion and spray copper oxychloride.

column3: black sooty coating on leaves,sticky leaf surface,reduced growth
column4: Control the sucking pests that produce honey dew and wash the leaves with starch solution.

column3: rotting of roots,yellowing of whole plant,easy uprooting
column4: Improve drainage and drench with carbendazim or trichoderma around the root zone.
